output.content: I am checking the current deployment pipeline to see how the latest churn model gets promoted to production. There is no central repository tracking model versions or metadata. Each time I finish a training run, I manually copy the serialized artifact and its configuration file to a shared network drive. I then email the file path to the deployment team so they can pull it into the staging environment. This manual transfer happens for every single iteration. The staging environment currently holds version 4.2, which I pushed over three days ago. The production environment is still running version 3.1. I have no automated link between the training output and the serving infrastructure, so every update requires a direct file transfer and a manual restart of the inference container.
